$comment: CANONICAL project registry — single source of truth read by the website (site/lib/registry.ts), the terminal backend (Go), and deploy scripts (jq). Add a project = add one object here + drop a folder in labs/<slug>/. See README.md 'Project Registry'. web.port is the HOST-loopback port used for cloudflared ingress (scripts/sync-cloudflared-ingress.sh) — it is NOT reachable from inside the terminal container (different network namespace), so the Go backend's /api/status liveness check instead dials web.checkHost:web.checkPort, the project's compose container_name + container-internal listen port on the shared egolab_edge Docker network.

projects.title: Sepotipai
projects.description: A Spotify-like playlist & queue manager written in C, exploring linked lists, queues, and file-backed persistence.

lab.blurb: Type START, then LIST / PLAY / QUEUE / HELP.

projects.title: BurBir
projects.description: A Twitter-like social app in C (users, tweets, replies, threads, friend graph) built on hand-rolled ADTs for the Algorithm & Data Structures course.

lab.blurb: Every input needs a trailing ";" — just ";" to load, then DAFTAR; to register, KICAU; to post.

projects.title: HTML Checker
projects.description: Validates HTML syntax with a Pushdown Automaton derived from a context-free grammar — a Theory of Computation project.

lab.blurb: htmlcheck <file.html> — try the samples in test/.

projects.title: Digital Image Edges
projects.description: Classical edge-detection operators (Sobel, Prewitt, Roberts, Laplacian, LoG) — ported from the original MATLAB coursework to a headless Python CLI.

projects.title: CLI game
projects.description: A Stardew-Valley-style farming sim CLI game — planting, harvesting, and a shop, built in C++20 for the Strategi Algoritma course.

lab.blurb: At the state prompt, type 1 for a fresh default game (or 2 then example/state.txt to load the seed save).

projects.title: LinkedIn Clone — Milestone 1
projects.description: A LinkedIn-style job platform built as vanilla PHP MVC on PostgreSQL: auth, profiles, job postings, and applications.

projects.title: CBIR Image Retrieval
projects.description: Content-Based Image Retrieval using linear-algebra methods (color histograms + texture co-occurrence) with a React front end.

projects.title: WikiRace Solver
projects.description: Finds the shortest click-path between two Wikipedia articles with BFS and IDS, visualised as a graph. Go back end, React front end.

projects.title: LinkedIn Clone — Milestone 2
projects.description: The milestone-1 platform rebuilt on a modern stack: Express + Prisma API, React/Vite front end, real-time chat over WebSockets, and web-push notifications.

projects.title: RiilCert
projects.description: Decentralized certificate issuance & verification on a Sepolia smart contract — wallet-signed auth, SHA-256 document hashing, AES encryption, and an immutable on-chain revoke/verify history.

projects.title: SigmaChat
projects.description: End-to-end encrypted real-time chat: ECC P-256 signatures and symmetric encryption over WebSockets, Express + Drizzle/PostgreSQL backend.

projects.title: Predator-Prey ABM
projects.description: Agent-based model of predator-prey population dynamics on a toroidal grid ocean — ported from a matplotlib desktop app to a headless server + canvas replay.

projects.title: LostOnesWeeping OS
projects.description: A bare-metal x86 OS from scratch — bootloader, kernel, FAT32 filesystem, and a userspace shell (ls, cat, mkdir, ps, exec) — for the Operating Systems course. Boots for real, in QEMU, from the SSH/playground menu — select "Launch OS".

projects.title: This Website
projects.description: The site you're on — a hand-written vanilla SPA turned into an SSH-able lab you can drop into over the terminal above.
